description: What the window is allowed to ask the core to do. Opening a link is the only thing the window can send off the machine: to Steam, because every review the page shows has to be checkable at its source; to a release page of SteamGauge itself, where a newer version is downloaded; and to SteamGauge's documentation, source and issue forms, each by its one exact address. The release pattern's wildcard would also match a path that climbs out of the releases, an encoded one, a query, a fragment or a further segment, so those are denied. A backslash is not denied by a pattern of its own because the opener's glob takes it for a slash on Windows, where such a pattern would deny every release page; the two dots it would need to climb anywhere are denied.
